riverbed.note: Root html background, footer/topbar, input wells, track off-state. Deepest field.

river.note: Page background and theme-color; 197deg / 55% saturation — an explicitly tinted surface, not black-with-a-hint. Light stop of the world gradient.

stone.note: Default panel/card/table ground; the surface every ink contrast ratio is measured on.

stone-2.note: Raised/hover/active surface: selected tab, hovered row, focused search fill, scrollbar thumb.

ink-3.legalUse: captions, section notes, table headers — the faintest legal text color

ink-4.legalUse: STROKES / SEPARATORS / ICONS ONLY — never a color: for text

radiant.note: Left/top branch of the axis. Fills nodes, camp rails, win states. Meaning, never decoration.

radiant-ink.legalUse: Radiant values set as text (score, names, tallies)

dire.note: Right/bottom branch. Pairs with radiant as a red/green pair the colorblind cannot separate — hence the Never-Only-Color rule.

aegis.note: The one true accent. Actionable-or-won only: buttons, focus ring, caret, selection, minute-scrub, active sort, copy-ID, MVP, decisive fights, milestones, Roshan node.

shard.note: The only blue in the system. Appears solely as the inset ring on scepter/shard item slots; it is the item's color, not the interface's.

display.purpose: The match outcome word (camp-colored) and home/profile headline. Rare and huge.

headline.purpose: Section titles and the spine readout title. letter-spacing 0 — hierarchy from size/weight/air, not tracking or caps.

stat-numeral.purpose: The .num class and every KDA/gold/duration figure: PT Sans Narrow, tabular lining numerals, right-aligned so columns sum at the digit.

body.purpose: Golos Text prose, notes, descriptions. Measures capped near 62–72ch.

label.purpose: Table headers, section notes, chips. 500 weight, not uppercase.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: Default panel lift at rest — the inset top hairline reads as ambient, the long low-alpha drop reads as resting height.

shadows.name: shadow-pop
shadows.purpose: Floating state only: hero plate, recent-search dropdown, chart tooltip.

shadows.name: backdrop-blur
shadows.value: blur(12px) over color-mix(in oklab, var(--stone) 88%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: The ONLY translucency — sticky subnav. Everything else is opaque.

shadows.name: team-flag-glow
shadows.purpose: The single deliberate glow exception (.team-flag 3px camp bar). Do not extend — depth stays tonal.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (hover, focus, color).

motion.name: d-hit
motion.purpose: Instant response for hover/scan states — data is scanned hundreds of times a session.

motion.name: d-load
motion.purpose: The one orchestrated moment: hero-plate background + world-layer load.

motion.name: keyframes:stage-rise
motion.purpose: Transform-only entrance; intentionally NO opacity so content is never invisible on any frame. Staggered 0/70/140ms.

browserSurfaces.name: scrollbar
browserSurfaces.purpose: The browser scrollbar is themed to the world.

browserSurfaces.name: focus-visible
browserSurfaces.value: outline: 2px solid var(--aegis); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: var(--r-node)
browserSurfaces.purpose: Global visible keyboard focus ring — gold.

breakpoints.name: bp-700
breakpoints.value: 700px (fights collapse, spine field 132px, timeline axis hides)

cornerRanking.name: r-plate
cornerRanking.purpose: Hero scoreboard plate only — largest corner in the system.

components.css: .ds-spine { margin-top:24px; padding:24px 24px 16px; border:1px solid var(--rule, rgba(150,202,216,.14)); border-radius:var(--r-panel,9px); background:var(--stone,#19414d); font-family:'Golos Text',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field { position:relative; height:168px; } .ds-axis { position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:50%; height:1px; background:var(--rule-2, rgba(150,202,216,.28)); } .ds-run { position:absolute; height:calc(74px * var(--peak,.3)); min-height:12px; opacity:.9; } .ds-run.r { bottom:50%; border-bottom:2px solid var(--radiant,#4fd18b); background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(79,209,139,.04), rgba(79,209,139,.30)); } .ds-run.d { top:50%; border-top:2px solid var(--dire,#ef5f4f); background:linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(239,95,79,.04), rgba(239,95,79,.30)); } .node { position:absolute; top:50%; width:6px; height:6px; margin-top:-3px; border-radius:var(--r-node,2px); transform:translateX(-50%); } .node.r { background:var(--radiant,#4fd18b); } .node.d { background:var(--dire,#ef5f4f); } .node.n-roshan { background:var(--aegis,#f0c46a); width:9px; height:9px; margin-top:-4.5px; transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg); } .node.n-fight { border-radius:50%; } .ds-scrub { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; margin:0; appearance:none; background:transparent; cursor:crosshair; } .ds-scrub::-webkit-slider-thumb { appearance:none; width:2px; height:168px; border:0; border-radius:0; background:var(--aegis,#f0c46a); cursor:crosshair; } .ds-scrub::-moz-range-thumb { width:2px; height:168px; border:0; background:var(--aegis,#f0c46a); } .ds-scale { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; margin-top:12px; color:var(--ink-3,#89acb8); font:400 11px/1 'PT Sans Narrow',sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-at { color:var(--aegis,#f0c46a); font-weight:700; }

narrative.overview: One minute axis runs across a river-teal field, and the whole product is drawn off it. The background is not dark — it is river water (#12323c, 197deg, 55% saturation), a genuinely colored surface, the deepest point where the two camps meet. Everything else — hero plate, rosters, charts, timeline — is arranged as branches of that axis. The world is monochrome-teal apart from three meaning pigments: the Radiant/Dire camp pair (state, never decoration), Aegis gold (the only actionable-or-won signal), and one borrowed blue for the Aghanim's Shard that arrives from the item, not the interface. Exactly one dark world; the light theme was removed on purpose.
keyCharacteristics: One minute axis over colored water; the two camps are its two branches.
Camp color (green/red) is never the sole carrier of meaning — glyph shape, row order, and the lane map are independent cues.
Aegis gold appears only where something is actionable or was won; its rarity is the point.
Ranked radii, one per hierarchy tier — never a single blanket corner.
Ink is tinted from the river's own hue; there are no neutral grays on a colored ground.
Flat by default; tonal layering does the depth work, and two structural shadows are reserved for states.

rules.name: The Never-Only-Color Rule
rules.body: Camp color is never the sole carrier of meaning; a row's allegiance and outcome are legible from the position glyph, the fixed 1->5 order, and the lane map, plus a filled-vs-hollow node — because Radiant vs. Dire is a red/green pair.

rules.name: The Aegis Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only on things you can act on or things that were won. Its rarity is the point; secondary actions stay un-gilded.

rules.name: The Tinted-Ink Rule
rules.body: No neutral grays on colored water; every ink is mixed from the river's hue, and --ink-4 (#4a6b77, 2.37:1) is strokes/separators/icons only, never a color for text.

rules.name: The One-Family-For-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every statistic numeral is PT Sans Narrow with tabular figures, right-aligned; a new number never introduces a mono font.

rules.name: The Don't-Shout Rule
rules.body: Section labels and headings do not use letter-spacing-as-noise or ALL-CAPS; hierarchy is carried by size, weight and air.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit at the tone that means their depth; shadows answer state, not decoration; a node is filled or hollow, never lit.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule (with one exception)
rules.body: Camp and gold do not glow; the single legacy exception is the .team-flag camp bar. Do not extend it.

dos: Do keep one dark world; color-scheme: dark on :root, no light override to add.
Do treat camp color as one carrier among several (glyph, row order, lane map, filled-vs-hollow node).
Do reserve --aegis for actionable or won states only.
Do place --shard blue only on scepter/shard item rings.
Do use the ranked radii by tier (2/5/9/16/999px) and --r-pill on tracks/scales, never cards.
Do set every statistic numeral in PT Sans Narrow tabular-nums lining-nums, right-aligned.
Do convey depth tonally (riverbed->river->stone->stone-2 + hairline rules); reach for --shadow-pop only on a floating surface.
Do respect the contrast ledger: body at --ink/--ink-2, captions at --ink-3 (min).
Do keep hover feedback at 70ms and save the only long sequence for the three-stage page entrance.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: zero durations and flatten the staging.
donts: Don't use --ink-4 (#4a6b77, 2.37:1) as text — strokes, separators, icon weights only.
Don't glow; filled-or-hollow beats lit, and the .team-flag glow should not spread.
Don't introduce a third typeface or a mono for numbers; don't resurrect Oswald or JetBrains Mono.
Don't reach for neon, decorative grids, or a blanket corner.
Don't fake data to fill the role system — render position/lane only where a real source exists and dim it when inferred.
Don't split the source of truth: --river/--stone/--radiant/--aegis/--shard are the project's own names; do not rename to generic design-system roles.
